props.heading: Help center
props.introduction: Short answers. If yours isn't here, call 1-800-555-0163, Monday to Friday, 7 to 5 Pacific.

questions.title: When will my order ship
questions.answer: In-stock gear ships in 1 to 2 business days from Kent, WA. Drops ship in 3. You'll get a tracking number by email.

questions.title: Shipping cost
questions.answer: Free over $99 in the US and Canada. Under that, $8 ground. Expedited is $22 and arrives in 2 business days.

questions.title: International
questions.answer: We ship to Germany, France, and Japan from local stock. Duties are included at checkout.

questions.title: Order status
questions.answer: Check the tracking link in your confirmation email, or sign in to your account.

questions.title: Return window
questions.answer: 60 days, worn or not. Bring it to a store or mail it back with the prepaid label from your account.

questions.title: Exchanges
questions.answer: Same as returns. Stores exchange on the spot if the size is in stock.

questions.title: Repaired and Drops gear
questions.answer: Same 60-day window. Drops can't be exchanged for a different size once the run has sold out.

questions.title: What's covered
questions.answer: Seams, zips, snaps, seam tape, reproofing, and re-knit wool on any Ballard gear, any age. Free, except reproofing at $35.

questions.title: How long
questions.answer: About two weeks from the day we receive it. Store repairs are usually faster.

info.heading: Account
info.text: Accounts, saved gear, and sign-in aren't wired up in this demo. Everything else on the site works without one.

info.heading: Pro purchase
info.text: Commercial fishing crews, guides, and trades get 30% off the main line with a current license or union card. Apply in any store.

info.heading: Accessibility
info.text: We build to WCAG 2.2 AA. If you're using a screen reader and something isn't working, call 1-800-555-0163 and we'll take the order by phone.

info.heading: Privacy and terms
info.text: This is a demo site. The bag is stored in your browser only. Nothing you type in a form is sent anywhere.
